title: Hits and misses: Alisson back to his best while Chelsea go back to square one
body: Sky Sports' football writers analyse Sunday's Premier League action as Alisson stars in Liverpool's win at Crystal Palace, Chelsea are out-muscled at Sunderland, Brentford's ill-discipline costs them against Brighton, and Bournemouth are on a roll... Sunday 8 November 2026 18:41, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Liverpool hit three at Palace, with three £100m+ players - Florian Wirtz, Alexander Isak and, with an assist, Bradley Barcola - involved in the goals. But it was their goalkeeper Alisson who was Liverpool's best performer. Crystal Palace will be so frustrated because on another day, the narrative could have swung their way. But the brilliant Brazilian delivered in key moments in the game. His save from Daichi Kamada's volley was an exceptional reaction stop. Two minutes later Liverpool took the lead. Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Alisson was then at full stretch to push away Adam Wharton's header to ensure Liverpool went into the break with the advantage. And on 77 minutes, with the score 2-0, he prevented Yeremy Pino from setting up a grandstand finish by shutting down the angle to save the one-on-one. Alisson may have had fortune with Pino hitting the bar when he was beaten early in the contest and he lost out on a clean sheet due to a controversial late Eddie Nketiah penalty, but in between he reminded everyone why he has been the Premier League's standout goalkeeper since his arrival in 2018. title: Official | Waldemar Anton withdraws from Germany squad, Ridle Baku earns late call-up
snippet:
Jürgen Klopp has recalled RB Leipzig's Ridle Baku to the Germany squad following Waldemar Anton's withdrawal through injury. 

Meanwhile, Baku's Leipzig teammates Brajan Gruda and David Raum made headlines with impressive performances against Augsburg, with the latter responding to his omission from
body: Germany head coach Jürgen Klopp has recalled RB Leipzig’s Ridle Baku to the national team after Borussia Dortmund defender Waldemar Anton withdrew from the upcoming UEFA Nations League fixtures against Serbia and the Netherlands. Dortmund confirmed on Sunday afternoon that the 30-year-old centre-back would be unavailable for international duty because of muscular problems. The German Football Association subsequently announced that Baku would replace Anton in Klopp’s squad. The development comes just three days after Klopp announced his original 24-man squad for November’s international fixtures . Baku was among several prominent players omitted from the original selection, despite featuring in Klopp’s first Germany squad during the September and October international window. Baku did not end up logging any minutes in Klopp’s first four fixtures in charge of die Nationalmannschaft . The 28-year-old Leipzig defender has recently demonstrated his attacking qualities at club level, scoring in Wednesday’s 3-2 Champions League defeat against Manchester City. He also started Saturday’s 5-2 Bundesliga victory over Augsburg. Overall, Baku has scored three goals and contributed one assist in 13 appearances for Leipzig across all competitions this season. Baku’s Leipzig teammate Brajan Gruda will also join Klopp’s squad following an outstanding individual performance in Saturday’s 5-2 victory over Augsburg. title: England await Guehi scan results after injury concern
snippet: Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will undergo a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can report for England duty this week.
body: Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Guehi joined Manchester City from Crystal Palace in January Senior football correspondent Published 4 hours ago Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will undergo a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can report for England duty this week. The 26-year-old was substituted at half-time of City's loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday and manager Enzo Maresca revealed afterwards the centre-back had requested to come off because of the injury. Maresca did not specify Guehi's issue, but it is understood he has been troubled by the hip problem in recent weeks. The fact he requested to be substituted has placed doubt over whether he will be available for England's Uefa Nations League matches against Croatia and Spain. Guehi will undergo tests, although it is likely England medical staff will also want to assess the player before a final decision is made. Thomas Tuchel will be hoping the defender is passed fit, with the former Crystal Palace captain a mainstay of his team since his appointment as England head coach in January 2025. Guehi started in all but one of England's games at the World Cup and all four of the team's Nations League fixtures in September and October. England face Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, 12 November, before travelling to Madrid to face World Cup winners Spain on Saturday, 15 November. title: Manuel Neuer expected to be sidelined for six weeks
snippet:
At the age of 40 years and 225 days, Neuer became the oldest player ever to represent Bayern Munich in a Bundesliga match, surpassing the club’s previous record. \

The landmark appearance instead ended with another injury setback and renewed uncertainty over when Bayern’s long-serving No. 1 will ne
body: Manuel Neuer is expected to miss at least six weeks after suffering another significant foot injury during Bayern Munich’s 2-1 Bundesliga victory over Mainz on Saturday. Sky Germany reports that the 40-year-old is set to miss the remainder of the calendar year after being forced off shortly before half-time at the MEWA Arena. Bayern subsequently confirmed that Neuer sustained a partial tendon tear in his right foot, with the diagnosis established following an examination by the club’s medical department. The German record champions have not provided an official recovery timetable. According to Abendzeitung reporter Patrick Strasser , the best-case scenario would see Neuer return following the winter break in January. A longer rehabilitation period could keep the Bayern captain out until February. The latest setback is particularly concerning given Neuer’s recent problems with the same foot. The veteran goalkeeper had already missed matches this season because of persistent tendon irritation and only recently returned to action. The injury also arrives at a significant point in Neuer’s career. His current Bayern contract expires at the end of the season, and the 2014 World Cup winner has already strongly indicated that the 2026/27 campaign is likely to be his last as a professional .
